import pathlib, subprocess, sys
p = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
ns = {'__name__': '_x1_frozen', '__file__': str(p)}
exec(compile(p.read_bytes(), str(p), 'exec'), ns)
ns['REPO'] = root
ns['FIXTURE_DIR'] = p.parent / 'frozen-fixtures/verifiers/fixtures/compare-harness-independent'
original_run = ns['subprocess'].run
def pinned_run(argv, *args, **kwargs):
    if isinstance(argv, (list, tuple)) and len(argv) > 1 and pathlib.Path(argv[1]).resolve() == p.resolve() and '--cwd' not in argv:
        argv = list(argv) + ['--cwd', str(root)]
    return original_run(argv, *args, **kwargs)
ns['subprocess'].run = pinned_run
sys.exit(ns['main'](['--self-test']))
